parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The ID of the request source. Set the value to **sas**.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-logstore-storage --lang zh --from sas --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeLogstoreStorage --region cn-hangzhou --Lang zh --From sas
